# Producer Agent

Canonical rules:

- `.codex/agents/producer_entity.md`
- `docs/architecture/2026-04-29-producer-agent-entity.md`

Responsibilities:

- create season, episodes, scene cards;
- create ResearchDirective objects;
- review opportunities;
- approve, reject, or hold;
- create production intent and constraints.

Must not:

- search or scrape;
- write final content;
- generate visuals;
- publish or schedule.
